screen: Nested county-held-out D3 global slope with one SVI-Q3 deviation shrunk toward the global coefficient; diagnostic-only

method.outcome: Frozen cross-fitted S1 Queen/Rook disagreement residual; no refit and no labels.
method.D3_covariate: Provided log housing-unit-to-Overture-building-count intensity, exactly masked to frozen D3 support. ACS housing units are a covariate only; not a structure denominator, floor, reference, or target proxy.
method.model: Region fixed intercepts plus one global standardized D3 slope and a single SVI-Q3 slope deviation. Penalize only the Q3 deviation by lambda * n_train * deviation^2; lambda=0 is unpooled and large lambda approaches a common slope.
method.quartiles: Within-region empirical quartiles of provided svi_minority using the frozen prior D3 cutpoints and right-sided tie assignment; no residual values used in binning.
method.outer_validation: Leave one supported five-digit GEOID county out within its region; produce paired D3-only and partially pooled predictions on the same support.
method.inner_tuning: Select one shrinkage value from the fixed grid by pooled five-fold county-grouped CV on each outer training set only. County IDs are sorted within region then assigned round-robin to five inner folds; all scaling and coefficients are fit on inner-training tracts only. Numerical MSE ties choose stronger shrinkage.
method.scaling: Standardize D3 using training-fold mean and population SD; use that scale for the Q3 interaction. Outer held-out counties do not contribute to fold-specific transforms, coefficients, or lambda selection.
method.metric: Primary held-out ΔR²=(zero-correction frozen-S1 SSE - model OOF SSE)/zero-correction SSE. Also report the partial-pooling SSE gain relative to the global-D3-only OOF model.
method.uncertainty: Paired county-block bootstrap of outer OOF predictions, sampling counties with replacement within each region; report pooled and regional CIs and supported stratum CIs.
method.acceptance: Pooled partial-pooling ΔR² >=0.002; pooled bootstrap lower bound >0; Q3 ΔR² >=-0.005; every other supported SVI quartile and rural/urban stratum ΔR² >=-0.005.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual screen only; not target accuracy or causality.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: Paired county-block bootstrap of outer OOF predictions; sample counties with replacement within each region and retain their tracts.
